name: Be My Muse
source:
You join an art exhibition at your local art museum, and while trying to get away from the crowd, you meet a strange man who, for some reason, really wants to paint a portrait of you.

[From [url=https://batter-sempai.itch.io/be-my-muse]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你来到当地美术馆参观展览。为了避开人群，你遇上了一名奇怪的男子。不知为何，他非常想为你画一幅肖像。

[摘自[url=https://batter-sempai.itch.io/be-my-muse]Itch.io[/url]]
